opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with a UK or ROI address and bank account) or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; not resubmit an unsuccessful application unless invited; and have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach activities, supporting members, individuals and organisations to run projects connecting communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences. Prioritises projects that connect under-represented audiences with chemical science, develop members' engagement skills, support positive social outcomes, and engage families/adults with chemistry.
